task: Friends Room reward reveal, fixed actor geometry and 3-second shared coin animation
scope: Client only; no database migration, server rule change or API deployment

behavior.rewardTrigger: Native entrance completion of the first post-answer reply, not answer tap, network receipt, summary or Done
behavior.rewardAmount: Existing prepared 5/10-coin choice; authoritative server receipt still reconciles eligibility and balance
behavior.outbox: Existing durable coin operation and visit cursor retained; reply reading and navigation never wait for network
behavior.reentryAndRetry: No repeated credit or celebration on restored jobs, duplicate callbacks, ambiguous retries or reentry
behavior.exit: Unseen held visual rewards are consumed silently so confirmed money is not stranded
behavior.accountAndPairFence: Old owner callbacks ignored; unpair cleanup can release same-owner held balance without replaying animation
behavior.rejection: Definitive refusal rolls back only the affected projection and its own celebration
behavior.actor: Same scale, canvas coordinates and canonical dialogue-stage anchor from welcome onward; two poses share one scale
behavior.lateReceipts: Retarget count without restoring fading opacity or extending the existing flight deadline
behavior.continuousRewards: Merge active flights; a subsequent distinct flight owns its own 3-second window without rewinding count
behavior.persistentWallet: Remains visible; only the temporary reward wallet fades away
behavior.serialization: Small confirmed wallet receipt cached immediately; full room serialization deferred past the longer animation
behavior.buttonsAndNavigation: No new input lock, waiting screen or forced 3-second navigation delay
